newsitem.title: POLAND: POLES POLLED ON DANCE PARTNER OF THEIR DREAMS.
newsitem.headline: POLES POLLED ON DANCE PARTNER OF THEIR DREAMS.

text.p: Poles differ widely in their idea of the dreamiest partner with whom to dance in the New Year, but more long to cut the rug with their central bank chief than with the country's top beauty queen.
The public CBOS polling institute asked a representative sample of 1,115 Poles to name the celebrity they most fancied stepping out with at a New Year ball.
Clear favourite with six percent was 42-year-old President Aleksander Kwasniewski, coming ahead of a popular male television presenter with three percent, CBOS said in a report published on Monday.
National Bank of Poland head Hanna Gronkiewicz-Waltz, 44, tied for third place with two percent -- among others with former President Lech Walesa and First Lady Jolanta Kwasniewska.

She beat Miss Polonia Agnieszka Zielinska, who got only one percent -- the same as this year's Nobel literature prize-winner, frail, elegant 73-year-old poet Wislawa Szymborska, who is known for shunning public appearances.
CBOS was struck by the fact that more Poles fancied politicians than other prominent figures.
"Could it be that our political class is more attractive than representatives of the world of film, stage and sport?" the institute's report asked.
